issues.description: Method SealSaloon.checkOrderReady(): The problem statement (UML) declares checkOrderReady() with return type void (problem_statement.md line 32), but the solution implementation declares public boolean checkOrderReady() (src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java line 20). This discrepancy between the specified signature and the provided implementation can confuse students about the expected method contract and may cause tests or grading code that expect a void method to fail or require rework.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature consistent between specification and implementation. Either (A) update the problem statement/UML to declare checkOrderReady() returns boolean and document the meaning of the return value, or (B) change the solution (and any tests) so checkOrderReady() is void and any boolean result is handled internally (e.g., store state or print only). Ensure the updated specification and tests reflect the chosen signature.

issues.description: Attribute SealSaloon.stock initialization/staticness: The problem statement text instructs that the SealSaloon's attributes (orders and stock) should be initialized in the constructor (problem_statement.md line 70), but later explicitly requires the stock attribute to be static and shared across instances (problem_statement.md lines 77-80). The solution declares the stock as a static final field initialized inline (src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java line 5). The problem statement therefore contains conflicting instructions about whether stock is instance-initialized in the constructor or a static/shared attribute.
issues.suggestedFix: Clarify the specification: decide whether stock is shared across all SealSaloon instances or instance-specific. If stock should be shared, explicitly state in the problem statement that stock is static (and may be initialized inline or in a static block) and remove the instruction to initialize it in the constructor. If stock should be instance-specific, remove the requirement that it be static and update the solution/tests accordingly.
